\\u0060CardBadges\\u0060 reads cars.com, Autotrader and carvana badges off card text. \\u0060WalkSite.CardBadgeReader\\u0060 and \\u0060ReadCardBadges\\u0060 wire it into the site definitions.\\n  - \\u0060PostingAttributeNames\\u0060 holds the attribute names (\\u0060deal\\u0060, \\u0060demand\\u0060, \\u0060dealer-rating\\u0060, \\u0060price-drop\\u0060, \\u0060paperwork\\u0060, \\u0060shipping\\u0060).\\n  - \\u0060ListingCandidate.Attributes\\u0060 is stored by \\u0060UpsertAsync\\u0060. \\u0060SetPostingAttributesByUrlAsync\\u0060 refreshes postings by URL.\\n  - \\u0060KnownCardTouches.TryTouchAsync\\u0060 now takes the card\\u0027s badges as a third argument, and so does the \\u0060touchKnownAsync\\u0060 delegate in \\u0060WalkSearchPages\\u0060. \\u0060BadgesOfNewLink\\u0060 hands a new link\\u0027s badges to its detail visit.\\n  - \\u0060RankCommand.ForScoring\\u0060 is now public and builds \\u0060VehicleForScoring\\u0060, including the display-only \\u0060SiteBadge\\u0060. \\u0060SiteBadgeText\\u0060 turns a posting\\u0027s attributes into \\u0060GrD 4.9\\u0060-style text.\\n- **Gotchas:**\\n  - Badge matching is exact and case-sensitive per line.\\n  - A name a card doesn\\u0027t show is never cleared, so a badge that disappears stays on the posting until a later card sets it again.\\n  - Autotrader may record nothing live until its card container is confirmed from a real page. \\u0060SearchPageLinks\\u0060 uses the nearest ancestor containing a dollar amount, and Autotrader\\u0027s price has none.\\n  - The site field comes from the cheapest active posting, not from every posting of the vehicle.\\n- **Left undone on purpose:**\\n  - Nothing scores on badges (Brian\\u0027s ruling).\\n  - The insurance-unknown and F-graded rank tables don\\u0027t show the site field, since only the ranked and over-budget rows carry it.\\n  -
